author: Unity
description:
After the launch of their VR game 'Does It Stack?', Belgian game studio Cybernetic Walrus found itself in a precarious financial position, with only four months of operational runway remaining. This urgent situation meant they needed to come up with a way to make a hit game – fast.

Hear from Cybernetic Walrus CEO Mike Coeck and technical development lead Baptiste Deboutte on how they achieved this through the Momentum Framework, a repeatable, six-step development process focused on rapid iteration and market validation. Learn how this strategy, combined with tools from Unity 6 and the Unity Asset Store, helped them secure a win with their latest release, Roadside Research.

Play Roadside Research: https://on.unity.com/PlayRoadsideResearch

Watch more videos: https://on.unity.com/resources

[0:00] - Intro & The Momentum Framework in 6 steps
[0:30] - Steps 1 & 2: Roadmapping and building a teaser
[1:13] - Steps 3 & 4: Marketing the teaser and making a demo
[1:43] - Steps 5 & 6: Online
title: How making a game In under 4 months saved the Roadside Research devs
